description: Use when the user asks "which flights between X and Y have Starlink?" or "what Starlink flights serve airport X?". Single-route lookup: returns tracked airlines flight numbers on a route (or touching an airport) ranked by Starlink probability. Both origin and destination are required (per-airline route comparison). For trip planning with connections, use plan_starlink_itinerary instead — this tool has no connection logic or coverage-ratio ranking. Empty result = route not served by Starlink planes.

limit.description: Maximum number of flight numbers to return (default 10).

name: predict_route_starlink
title: Starlink odds by route
